title: Opptra service manifest
description: Every app repository has a service.yaml at its root. The reusable workflows read it.

name.description: Cloud Run service name. Lowercase, starts with a letter.

prod_project.description: Existing production GCP project for this app. Staging always uses opptra-staging.

region.description: Cloud Run region. Default for new apps is asia-south1.

auth.description: How a person reaches the app. app-login means the app has its own login and Cloud Run is publicly invokable. iap puts Identity-Aware Proxy in front. public is an anonymous site.
